purpose: Single locked evaluation of the final Phase 1 segmentation configuration before freezing the model for Phase 2 quantitative LV analysis.
decision_rule: The test results are descriptive final evaluation results only. They will not be used to alter the selected architecture, training hyperparameters, loss, threshold, or postprocessing.
historical_test_exposure_note: This partition was inspected during earlier pilot development before the clean Phase 1 rebuild. It was not used for model selection during clean Phases 1A–1D; therefore this evaluation is treated as the locked final evaluation of the clean pipeline, but not claimed to be a pristine never-inspected independent test set.
